facts.value: Null csP or zero duration is inactive. Otherwise decrement duration once; dispatch only when it reaches zero. Zero duration operands continue dispatch immediately; nonzero duration suspends and commits the advanced cursor. WaitIfMotionId compares an unsigned byte to motion_id and on equality sets duration=1 and returns without committing any local cursor progress, potentially replaying earlier immediate instructions from the batch start. Done clears csP and duration without neutralizing controls. Unknown opcodes are consumed with no default error; later fetches have no bounds check.

facts.value: At each outer iteration copy *cmd. If that byte exceeds 0xBF, advance and copy the first operand. Next compare the current *cmd to 0x7F; if greater, advance and copy another byte. Finally advance once. Thus the second test uses the first operand for opcodes above 0xBF, but the opcode otherwise. Done ends only at an outer-loop cursor position. Index, source length, and null pointers are unchecked; output appends without changing existing csP/duration.
